review_description: Darren, Steve, Andrew and the team at Southern Stars were a pleasure to deal with. Their sales/quoting process was not pressured and they considered our energy requirements in planning the quote. They were good at communicating and returning revised quotes in a timely manner. Andrew (installer) was polite and punctual and kept our yard neat and tidy. I would recommend their team to anyone looking into solar options.

Local company using a better quality product.  Written guarantee regarding exchange of damaged or broken units compared to having to wait while repairs are carried out.Most importantly all fittings were carried out by a local electrical company who have been working for the supplier for some time.
